title: Aluminium chain
h1: Aluminium production is concentrated in China, and bauxite trade in Guinea
deck: China made 60% of the world's alumina and primary aluminium in 2024 and exported little of either. Guinea supplied 67% of traded bauxite, and nine-tenths of it went to China.

chokepoint.physics: Smelting is continuous electrolysis. It used 13.9 MWh of electricity per tonne of metal on average in 2025
chokepoint.share: 60% of primary aluminium and 60% of alumina (2024); Guinea ships 67% of traded bauxite

usgs_mcs2026.unit: thousand metric tons; bauxite in dry tons, alumina in calcined equivalent weight
usgs_mcs2026.note: The 2024 column is used for shares. Every 2025 figure is a USGS estimate. The world bauxite total excludes US production, which is withheld. Values marked estimated by USGS for 2024: alumina for the United States, Brazil, Germany, India, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Spain and Turkey; bauxite for Brazil, China, Greece, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia and Vietnam; aluminium for Brazil, India, Malaysia and Norway.

rule_of_thumb.text: As a general rule, 4 tons of dried bauxite is required to produce 2 tons of alumina, which, in turn, can be used to produce 1 ton of aluminum.

usgs_mcs2025_estimates_for_2024.note: What the January 2025 edition estimated for 2024, before the revision.

smelting_power_coverage_2025_mt.note: The power figures are the association's World Reported total. Output that does not report, all outside China, has no power figure. The China figures are estimates from sources outside the industry.

lci_2019.bauxite_water_note: The bauxite input typically includes a water component of around 10 to 20%. 35% of world alumina production reported. No Chinese plants reported these flows.

trade_checks.note: The BACI record for Australia to China in 2023 carries a weight well below the neighbouring years at about three times the unit value. Its value is in line with them.

brazil_2018.ordered: In February, the Government of Brazil ordered a 6.3-million-ton-per-year alumina refinery and a nearby 10-million-ton-per-year bauxite mine to shut down one-half of their capacities, citing concerns that leaks from disposal areas may have taken place after heavy rainfall in the area.

brazil_2018.lifted: In May, a court in Brazil lifted restrictions on production at a 6.3-million-ton-per-year alumina refinery. [...] The mine and refinery were ramped up to their full capacities by yearend.
brazil_2018.lifted_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2020, Bauxite and Alumina, events of 2019
brazil_2018.note: 2017 figures are from the 2019 edition of the Mineral Commodity Summaries. 2018 figures are the later, final figures of the Minerals Yearbook 2022 (table 12 for alumina, table 13 for primary aluminium).

emirates.usgs_2020: In April, a new 2-million-ton-per-year alumina refinery in the United Arab Emirates was commissioned. In August, a new 12-million-ton-per-year bauxite mine in Guinea was commissioned and started exporting bauxite to the alumina refinery in the United Arab Emirates for which it would be the principal bauxite source.
emirates.usgs_2026: In August, the Guinean Government, following a dispute over the construction of an alumina refinery, revoked bauxite mining licenses from a subsidiary of a United Arab Emirates-based aluminum producer and reallocated the concessions to a state-backed mining company.

guinea_exports_q1_2025.note: Table 3 of the bulletin: alumina content and moisture of bauxite at export, by company. The table does not say whether alumina is total or available. One of thirteen companies reports no alumina figure; the printed average of 40.13% counts it as zero and is not used.

flow_model.method: Origin tracing with proportional mixing (Kastner, Kastner and Nonhebel, 2011) for each stage. Chaining the three stages is this study's own step.

inputs.trade: CEPII BACI V202601, customs net weight

assumptions: A country's exports have the same mix of origins as its supply (production plus imports) in that year.
A smelting country uses the national mix of alumina, and a refining country the national mix of bauxite.
Unwrought aluminium in trade includes alloys and remelted metal; production is primary metal only.
The alumina code covers all grades, not only smelter grade. Bauxite production is in dry tonnes and trade in customs weight.

unalloyed_metal_only.note: Unwrought alloy (HS 760120) left out of metal trade. A stress test: some smelting countries ship most of their metal as alloy.

traded_bauxite_less_10_per_cent_moisture.note: Bauxite trade tonnage multiplied by 0.9, against production in dry tonnes.
